Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِيْ فِيْهِ نَصِيْبًا مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ الوَاسِعَةِ
Translation: O Allah, grant me in it a share from Your vast mercy
And guide me in it to Your radiant proofs
And lead me by my forelock to Your all-encompassing pleasure
By Your love, O hope of those who yearn
